issues.description: The problem statement and plotting helper expect a function named simulate_msd_one_round, but the template defines simulate_one_round (different identifier). The solution implements simulate_msd_one_round. This naming mismatch between the template and the problem/solution will confuse students and break plot_msd (and tests) that call simulate_msd_one_round.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent across artifacts. Rename the template's simulate_one_round function to simulate_msd_one_round (and update its internal docstring/message), or change calls in problem/plot_msd to use simulate_one_round. Ensure the function name in the template matches the name used in the problem statement, plot_msd, and tests.
